1689:         Args:

1692:                 array is returned. Note that only valid datatypes will be moved to the GPU. Defaults to the device
1693:                 specified on annotator initialization.
1694:             do_array_copy: If ``True``, return a copy of the data. This is necessary if the data is expected to persist,
1695:                 such as when used in conjunction with asynchronous backends.
1696:             use_legacy_structure: Specifies the output structure to return. If ``True``, the legacy structure is

1703:

40:     disables eco mode, optionally puts the main Kit loop in manual mode, and defers disabling async rendering
41:     until after the play callback returns. When playback stops or pauses, it restores editing-oriented settings
